evidence: We are increasing the use of AI tools and technology and intend to integrate AI more broadly in our operations with the goal of increasing operational efficiencies, improve cycle times and improve decision-making
artificial intelligence (AI) based software is increasingly being used in the biopharmaceutical industry including by companies with which we compete
The integration of third-party AI technology with our operations relies on certain safeguards implemented by the third-party developers
ai_positioning.summary: HALO adopte une stratégie d'intégrateur d'IA, en déployant des outils et technologies IA tiers pour améliorer ses opérations internes, tout en reconnaissant les risques de sécurité et de conformité associés.
